most_important.why: 有無相生 etc.: the plan's 乙 example; six 相 X of different kinds
有生於無: asymmetric origin in the same text; 王弼 以無為本
同出而異名: 王弼 在首/在終 supports §4.2, but 王弼 adds 同出於玄 (a third, 冥默無有)
不可致詰，故混而為一: indistinguishable → one; the Hennessy–Milner direction that §4.4 only calibrates
歸根曰靜: the plan's test operation (§4.2)
復命曰常: the text's 常 is a return (loop), consonant with 有常 → 续不尽
知和曰常: a second definition of 常 (和)
獨立而不改，周行而不殆: 王弼 返化終始，不失其常 — constancy with unending circulation
大曰逝，逝曰遠，遠曰反: return defined as the limit of going
反者道之動: 反 polysemy (返 / inversion)
死而不亡者壽: 死 under one class, 不亡 under another; supports 亡于细者不必亡于粗
生生之厚: a different 生生 (living for life to excess), to be kept apart from 系辞's 生生
道生之，德畜之，物形之，勢成之: four stages of one course named by what each depends on (王弼 隨其所因，故各有稱焉)
得一: 王弼 居成則失其母 — settling into an achieved state ends a thing
王弼 非用清以清: a property does not keep itself (§4.5 自持/因于)
樸散則為器: 王弼 殊類生 — classes arise from the dispersal of a whole
物壯則老: the plan's 丙一 example; 已 = end
飄風不終朝，驟雨不終日: ending under intensity
天之道，損有餘而補不足 with its counterexample LZ-77-005 (人之道): a 丙一 whose condition is the domain
王弼 可得而親，則可得而疏: a 乙 candidate for correlative pairs
以其不自生，故能長生: continuation conditioned relationally (王弼 自生則與物爭)
道生一: 王弼 reads the count as produced by naming
夷、希、微: names defined by observations that fail to separate (§4.4 验)
失道而後德……: a degeneration chain; 王弼's 本末/母子 frame
合抱之木，生於毫末: 生 as the start of a course (the §4.3 sense), with LZ-63-004

contradictions_and_strains.plan: §三 乙 example (有无相生，王弼“不可偏舉”)
contradictions_and_strains.point: the same text says 有生於無, and 王弼 ranks 无 over 有 (凡有皆始於無; 有之所始，以無為本; 崇本以息末; 守母以存其子). 王弼's 不可偏舉 concerns the six pairs as names; citing him for a symmetric 有/无 needs this qualification. 王弼's 本/末 frame is a hierarchy not yet registered in §5.4

contradictions_and_strains.plan: §4.2 (两者同出而异名 = one course at two positions)
contradictions_and_strains.point: 王弼 supports the two positions (在首/在終) but adds 同出於玄, 玄 = 冥默無有, the source of both, and refuses to fix it (玄之又玄); the plan's reading drops this third term

contradictions_and_strains.plan: §4.4 (验: the converse, 不在核中则可分, is only a calibration)
contradictions_and_strains.point: 不可致詰，故混而為一 asserts “indistinguishable → one”; if 致詰 is finite-stage observation this is the direction the plan does not prove
王弼: classes (殊類) arise when the 樸 disperses, and naming introduces division (有分則失其極); a generative account of classes, ordered whole → many

contradictions_and_strains.plan: §一 (续 relative to a class) — support
contradictions_and_strains.point: 死而不亡 (王弼: 身沒而道猶存), neither 存 nor 亡 for 谷神, one 道 named 小 and 大 under two readings
常 defined as return (復命); 不改 with 周行而不殆; 王弼 居成則失其母. A second 常 (知和曰常, LZ-55-006) differs
生生之厚 is excessive living-for-life leading to death (王弼), and 益生曰祥 an ill omen: 老子's 生生 is not 系辞's; the plan's use must register the polysemy
可道之道非常道 bounds what naming reaches; the plan does not claim the 常道, so a strain, not a 反读
柔弱勝剛強 is contradicted by 繫辭 XCX-08-004 (其柔危，其剛勝邪)
